summary: Revised implementation plan for KungaCV faithfully adopting the vend-pixel/kungacv repository's Calm Editorial SaaS design system (#0A0A0B Ink, #0070F0 Brand Electric Blue, #FAF9F5 Warm Paper, Poppins typography, and authentic KungaCV logo mark), structured Kotlin CV Profile data classes (PersonalInfo, WorkExperience, Education, Skill, and extended sections), mobile-adapted workspace & editor flows, Cover Letter Studio, Job Tracker, and Gemini Career Coach.
